name: Clam
summary: Ngao is the plain clam on the harbor boards, sold by the kilogram without the Phù Long label.
howToEat: Order it by weight, or ask for ngao hấp xả, the steamed plate. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
